body.statement: Under conditional response-type exogeneity, treatment consistency, and outcome exclusion, every maintained latent law induces, for each stratum \(x\), a feasible response-fiber weight \(w_x\in\mathcal W_x(p_x)\). Hence response-fiber compatibility is derived rather than an additional assumption defining \(\mathfrak P_{\mathrm{IV}}\).
body.proof_tex: Let \(R=((A(z))_{z\in\mathcal Z},(Y(a))_{a\in\mathcal A})\in\mathcal R\) be the finite response type and define \(w_x(r)=P(R=r\mid X=x)\). Then \(w_x(r)\geq0\) and \(\mathbf 1^\top w_x=\sum_{r\in\mathcal R}w_x(r)=1\). Conditional response-type exogeneity makes this conditional law independent of \(Z\). Treatment consistency and outcome exclusion give, for every observed cell, \[ p_{xzay}=P(A=a,Y=y\mid X=x,Z=z)=\sum_{r\in\mathcal R}\mathbf 1\{a_r(z)=a,\ y_r(a)=y\}w_x(r)=(Bw_x)_{zay}. \] Therefore \(Bw_x=p_x\), and after deleting the redundant row equations and adjoining normalization, \(w_x\geq0\), \(\mathbf 1^\top w_x=1\), and \(\widetilde B w_x=\widetilde p_x\). Thus \(w_x\in\mathcal W_x(p_x)\), proving nonemptiness from the latent structural model without a separate compatibility restriction.
body.justification: This lemma removes a redundant maintained assumption while preserving exactly the same latent-law class.
body.gap: The observable fiber condition is a consequence of the structural response-type law, not an independent narrowing restriction.
body.consumer: All sharp-set, rectangle, witness, and face-intersection results use the derived fiber nonemptiness.
